events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated. Validation found that the new CRM automatically added +1 to numbers lacking country codes, making 31 overseas customers’ phone numbers incorrect. Batches 4–10 would have the same issue, so the remaining 280 records have not been migrated. Sales may already be relying on affected data: 14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; whether they viewed affected records is unknown. Please coordinate an immediate warning to sales not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers, and provide verified country codes/phone numbers for the affected records plus a corrected import process before migration resumes. No phone numbers have been guessed or manually changed.

events.text:
**Migration paused:** 120 of 400 records migrated; 31 overseas phone numbers received incorrect `+1` prefixes.

The remaining 280 records were not migrated to avoid repeating the error. Morgan Lee was notified immediately because sales may already rely on the data.

Resumption requires verified phone numbers and a corrected import process.
